sources.title: Hae Fuzz – Croy Tone Audio Technologies
sources.excerpt: CroyTone Audio Technologies describes the Hae Fuzz as an aggressive, brash and cutting fuzz that continues an octave-fuzz circuit the builder has developed over several years. The product is aimed particularly at alternative and shoegaze sounds associated with the 1980s and 1990s, with strong octave and ring-modulated textures, substantial output and flexible tone shaping.
